native_policy.positive_mask_hit: Layer MainImage stored alpha compared to HitThreshold; callbacks retain original ordering
native_policy.province_copy: dfProvince=3 copies 8-bit interaction labels, not RGBA. Missing source province fills the clipped source rectangle in the destination plane, per original CopyRect branch. Full zero FillRect deallocates the province plane; partial zero preserves allocation. AssignImages snapshots the province; SetImageSize retains content and fills newly exposed labels with zero.
native_policy.focus_defaults: Layer onBlur(focused) and onFocus(blurred,direction) forward native type/target dictionaries to the constructor Window.action owner. Missing action returns void; subtype super handlers remain callable. These are actual default event semantics, not ignored unknown calls.

engine_ownership: Generic scoped clip/copy/zero holes/resize and atomic fill budget belong to crysirror_core::region_map. Shared ImageJobs own bitmap graph preparation; native input is not acknowledged before ready. No private bitmap compositor is added.
